name: ding-pbx-console
description: A desktop control plane for guided Asterisk administration.
author: Ding-Ding-Projects

scripts.build: npm run compile:design && npm run bundle:docs && npm run write:update-manifest && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.package:squirrel: npm run bundle:asterisk && npm run build && electron-builder --win squirrel --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.test:inventories: node scripts/verify-inventories.mjs --allow-unverified && node scripts/negative-design-parity.mjs && node scripts/negative-surface-completeness.mjs && node scripts/negative-evidence-claims.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:ui && npm run test:renderer && npm run test:control-plane && npm run test:site && npm run test:inventories
